##### Project general facts

Riviera 58 by Azizi Developments is a residential building that blends the charm of Mediterranean design with contemporary elements to create an ideal setting for everyday living. The exterior is defined by crisp geometric lines and a combination of high-quality materials, giving the building a refined, modern presence. It rises from a ground floor to eight residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts, together with retail units at street level.

Residents enjoy swimming pools for adults and children with a poolside terrace, a fully equipped gym, indoor yoga and a spa for everyday wellness. A clubhouse, a co-working lounge, a TV lounge, a billiards area, an indoor multipurpose hall and an indoor children's play area add variety, while tennis and basketball courts, landscaped parks and gardens, restaurants, valet parking, an automated car wash and round-the-clock security complete the offer.

Every home features premium finishes, including wooden details, custom integrated lighting and Italian marble flooring, delivering a refined level of comfort. Large windows and balconies fill the interiors with natural light and frame views of the community and its greenery. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and built-in appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Azizi Riviera is a large waterfront community within Meydan One in Mohammed Bin Rashid City, inspired by the French Riviera and built around a crystal lagoon. A long boulevard lined with cafes, boutiques, supermarkets and restaurants, landscaped parks, walking paths and a lagoon beach create a lively yet relaxed setting, with everyday needs within walking distance of every building.

Al Khail Road and Meydan Road connect residents with the wider city. The Meydan Hotel and Meydan Racecourse are close by, Downtown Dubai, The Dubai Mall and Business Bay are a short drive away, and Dubai Design District, Dubai Festival City, the Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance for work, leisure and travel.

Azizi Riviera is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular mid-market waterfront addresses close to Downtown Dubai. Lagoon views, integrated retail and an established, fully serviced community attract professionals and families, supporting steady rental demand. Competitive prices and a central location underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
